title: Green Thai Curry
instructions: Cube the chicken, salt and pepper it, and fry over some oil until golden.
Cut the eggplant into small pieces, make sure theres some skin on every piece. Fry until golden on both sides, set aside.
Fry the cubed red bell pepper until golden/charred as well.
Now dice some onion and fry it until translucent.
Add the curry paste into the onion, deglaze with some water if needed, let bloom.
Add coconut milk and sugar, and let boil for a bit until fully dissolved.
Now return the chicken and veggies into the sauce. Adjust the taste using soy sauce, pepper, etc.
Cook for few minutes until all is fully incorporated.
Serve with some basil and rice.
